description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for encapsulating details related to leave request dates in the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes properties for from and to dates, duration details, and start/end times, along with their respective getters and setters.

classes.name: LeaveRequestDatesDetail
classes.description: A DTO class representing the detailed date information for a leave request, including start/end dates, duration type, and times.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize fromDate and optionally toDate.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Retrieves the start date of the leave request.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the leave request.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Retrieves the end date of the leave request, if set.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the leave request.

methods.name: getDurationTypeId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID representing the duration type.

methods.name: getDurationType
methods.description: Retrieves the string description of the duration type.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Retrieves the start time of the leave request.

methods.name: setStartTime
methods.description: Sets the start time of the leave request.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Retrieves the end time of the leave request.

methods.name: setEndTime
methods.description: Sets the end time of the leave request.
